name: Phishing lockdown
result: Fake invoices stopped before they land
alt: Office building inside a security perimeter
story: After a near-miss with a fake invoice email, we added multi-factor sign-in, email filtering and short staff training, then watched every account around the clock.

challenge: A law office of 18 people received an email that looked like a supplier invoice with new bank details. A bookkeeper caught it the day before payment.
The office had no multi-factor sign-in, only the spam filter that came with their email, and no security training.

steps.title: Multi-factor sign-in
steps.detail: Turned on for every account, with a short walk-through for each person.

steps.title: Email filtering
steps.detail: Added a filter that holds look-alike domains and checks links when they are clicked.

steps.title: Staff training
steps.detail: A 20-minute session, then short monthly lessons and practice phishing emails.

steps.title: Around-the-clock watch
steps.detail: Every account and device now reports to our security team.

results: No fake invoices have reached a staff inbox since the filter went in.
Clicks on practice phishing emails fell from 1 in 4 to 1 in 25 over six months.
Their cyber insurance renewal went through with a lower premium.
